orientation_source.description: Where the orientation of the pose comes from. ins: the latest autoware_orientation; no pose until the first one arrives. motion: the heading of the displacement between consecutive positions. none: unknown, the identity (heading east) with an rmse of 1.0 rad. ins_or_none (deprecated): ins once autoware_orientation has arrived, none until then.

use_gnss_ins_orientation.description: Deprecated: set orientation_source instead. Read only when orientation_source is not set: true is read as ins_or_none, false as motion.

gnss_pose_pub_method.description: 0: Instant Value 1: Average Value 2: Median Value. Any other value is rejected at startup.

buff_epoch.description: Number of positions the average / median is taken over (ignored for method 0)
